answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock collateral for 30 days, with request capacity proportional to the amount locked. Agents named falcon and shale follow the same rule: splitting one deposit across a thousand identities creates no extra capacity. To gain a delta of 1,000 requests per day at a posted rate of $10 per daily request, an attacker must immobilize $10,000 for a month, bearing its financing cost.
